cited.quote: operate as dedicated police stations headed by a Police Inspector under the respective District Superintendents of Police

rationale: C5 (GO 49, 2026-08-08) sets up Anti-Narcotics Task Force units as dedicated police stations under each District Superintendent of Police, with sanction. The promise's purpose is not stated; read as narcotics, the structure matches. Some doubt over the purpose.

cited.quote: SCERT conducts specialised leadership development programmes for Head Teachers

rationale: C1 and C5 show existing leadership training for head teachers run by SCERT, with no dedicated leadership training centre established. No GO, tender or sanction for such a centre appears in the extracts.

cited.quote: the Government of Tamil Nadu addressed a letter to the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India on February 15, 2026

rationale: C2 reports a letter to the Prime Minister dated 15 February 2026, before the government took office, and it concerns citizenship for Sri Lankan Tamils sheltered in Tamil Nadu, not rights and properties of Tamils in Sri Lanka. No other formal step on the issue.

cited.quote: internship training programmes will be provided in collaboration with Government and private industries to 20,000 youth

rationale: C2 is a budget speech announcing future internship training with industry (Vetri Skill Training Scheme) and an allocation; no GO or launch appears. C3, C4 and C5 show existing, older internship or OJT arrangements, not this commitment's operationalisation.

cited.quote: 56,589 Sri Lankan Tamils belonging to 19,751 families are accommodated in 105 camps

rationale: C2 describes camp welfare measures for Sri Lankan Tamils; C4 mentions insurance cards (undated document). Neither shows a new official step to extend all state welfare schemes to them. Related activity only.

cited.quote: the Government has proposed to bring the entire cultivated area under the ambit of PMFBY

rationale: C2 says the Government has only proposed to bring the entire cultivated area under PMFBY, with scheme outlay stated for 2026-27. A proposal is not an official step such as a GO; the scheme remains voluntary.

cited.quote: A handline tuna fishery cluster has been identified in Nagapattinam District

rationale: C1 describes a tuna cold-chain pilot under PMMSY in Nagapattinam, a different and smaller scheme. No extract shows an integrated export centre with cold storage, auction hall and processing units in Nagapattinam or Mayiladuthurai.

cited.quote: Government will extend subsidy to Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) for installing electric vehicle charging stations

rationale: C1 is a budget speech stating the government will extend the subsidy, with Rs.5 crore allocated. This is an announcement and allocation, not an operationalising GO or launch. Terms (50 percent, Rs.50000) are also not stated.

cited.quote: to provide world-class training to select school students aged 8 to 18

rationale: C3 (budget speech) only makes an allocation of Rs.5 crore for world-class training of select students aged 8 to 18; no GO or launch. C1 and C2 describe existing talent identification and Olympic Gold Quest schemes.

cited.quote: paving the way for preference in Government procurement to products

rationale: C1 only mentions the Union MSMED Act's procurement preference in general terms; C2 covers payment discounting for MSME vendors. No extract shows a state order reserving 40 percent of purchases for Tamil Nadu MSMEs.

cited.quote: 301.61 km of Integrated Stormwater Drain at an estimated cost of Rs.1,715.25 crore

rationale: C2 reports Chennai stormwater drain works under way (Kovalam Basin, 70 percent complete, balance by March 2027); C1 gives older sanctions for other cities. Works are ongoing but not operational, and their start is undated, so doubt remains whether they count for this government.

cited.quote: Speed Cameras (Fixed and Mobile), ANPR Cameras, Red Light Violation Detection

rationale: C2 and C1 describe electronic enforcement devices and camera installation already in place, undated and carrying on. C3 only says technology-based monitoring will be used. No new GO or dedicated AI speed-camera scheme for accident-prone highway stretches is shown.

cited.quote: This Government will strongly oppose the National Education Policy, 2020
a Special Legal Committee will be constituted to legally pursue the issue up to the Supreme Court

rationale: C1 and C2 (Governor's address, 2026-06-18) are statements of intent in future tense (will oppose, will be constituted). No resolution, filing or GO showing a formal act in parliament or courts appears.
C1 to C5 cover transgender welfare, disability, vigilance, asset returns and planning appeals. None is about statements or resolutions condemning impositions on state autonomy or identity.

cited.quote: progressively expanded to all colleges and schools across the State

rationale: C1 describes the MaNaM peer-support forum and psychological first aid being progressively expanded to schools, undated and an existing programme. No extract shows an order to appoint 5,000 counsellors; C3 mentions existing teacher counsellors.

cited.quote: subsidy of Rs.400 per cylinder for upto five cylinders annually

rationale: C1 shows an LPG subsidy only for Sri Lankan Tamil camp families, a different group and amount. C2 covers kerosene and LPG connection data in the PDS. No order depositing money for 6 cylinders to every family appears.

cited.quote: a Special Legal Committee will be constituted to legally pursue the issue up to the Supreme Court

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) says a Special Legal Committee will be constituted and a report published: future intent only. C4 and C5 are a Revenue Augmentation Committee on state revenues, a different body and purpose, not a legal committee against Union funding.

cited.quote: around 6,000 teachers have been trained under the TNSPARK Teacher Training Programme

rationale: C5 reports earlier TNSPARK teacher training (2025-26 context); C1 budget speech expands TN SPARK for students. No new scheme or GO for AI skill development for government school teachers is shown.

cited.quote: development of e-commerce platforms and mobile applications

rationale: C1 lists statewide handloom support, working capital loans and e-commerce plans for cooperative societies. Nothing is specific to Thiruvannamalai weavers or a new investment fund and e-commerce service for them.
C1 mentions the One Nation One Ration Card scheme, a different subject. C2 to C5 are an audit report, a medical directive GO and a planning appeals GO. None concerns the One Nation One Election bill.
